# Proverbs 16 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 16:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | All [the]-ways-of a-man [are] pure in-his-[own]-eyes, but-[the]-one-weighing spirits [is] YHWH. |
| LOGOS | All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the spirit. |
| PNEUMA | People always think they're doing the right thing, but the LORD looks at what's really driving them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
